name: double-cross
description: Double Cross: a spy-trap party game in Godot 4 for the web. Search furniture for intel, rig furniture and doorways, and reach the extraction door, alone or online with up to eight agents.

scripts.test:godot: godot --headless --path godot --import && godot --headless --path godot -s tests/test_maps.gd && godot --headless --path godot -s tests/test_net.gd
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run test:godot && npm run build && wrangler deploy
